steps.name: initial
steps.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise logo material-and-color edit.
Create one polished art variant called "Atmospheric Re-entry / 重返大气层" of the EXISTING supplied logo. Output the logo isolated on real transparent alpha; no text, no backdrop. It will be displayed on near-black navy #060B18.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the original logo and immutable geometry reference. Image 2 is a high-contrast part-separation guide of the same original logo: its orange areas identify ONLY the original visible orbit, and its blue areas are the body, diagonal connectors, dot, and rocket. Do NOT borrow that guide's palette or cream background.
INVARIANTS: Copy the exact original angular leaning H-like body, every cut angle, thin diagonal connector, original orbit arcs and front/back crossing gaps, lower-left round dot, and compact upper-right rocket with its original separated nose and fins. No redraw or reinterpretation. Same proportions, orientation, and relative positions. Do not simplify the elliptical path into a closed ring; do not fill narrow gaps. The diagonal shaft and triangular streak structures belong to the body, not the orbit. Keep all original colored surfaces solid, with only the original negative-space gaps transparent.
ART DIRECTION: A crisp premium modern logo whose surfaces convey controlled high-speed atmospheric compression heating. Heat is expressed through a coherent diagonal color progression and very sparse directional heat-flow striations INSIDE existing shapes. Not a burning logo, not a sci-fi scene, not metal or glass, not neon. Clean planar silhouette with subtle rich layered color fields. No material from the previous porcelain or vintage variants.
GLOBAL HEAT DIRECTION: lower left -> upper right, aligned with the rocket's flight. Keep a substantial cool starting zone. Lower-left dot, lower-left orbit, body foot and lower sections: deep space blue #0E2A66, visible against the intended dark backdrop. Body midsection rises through blue-violet #4A3EA8 into purple-magenta #A02E7A, increasing along the diagonal. The upper-left broad upright should remain mostly violet-blue, not orange. The upper-right body region and connectors approach magenta, with a very small restrained warm intrusion near the rocket. Most body area must remain blue/violet, with a smaller magenta transition; no white patches on the body.
ROCKET: hottest endpoint. Fins/root start magenta with restrained orange entering forward-facing areas, shaft becomes warm magenta-orange, nose mostly incandescent orange #F36A2D with a TINY pale hot cream #FFF2D8 highlight at its very tip only. Tip is the single hottest and brightest point. Preserve sharp compact nose, do not wash out whole rocket, no flames or exhaust.
ORBIT: retain its exact original width and outline. Make it feel like a controlled flowing thermal band: left and lower-left cool blue, front arc smoothly becomes violet then magenta toward the right, limited warm orange in the right/upturn segment. Returning/back segment may be a little cooler than the hottest front/upturn. Warm orbit stays dimmer than the rocket tip. Subtle layered color variation follows the arc INSIDE the existing orbit, not new parallel rings.
TEXTURE: Avoid a generic flat mechanical linear gradient. The overall continuous diagonal heat ramp has a few soft irregular advancing layers and extremely fine sparse stretched thermal streaks following flight, mainly in the medium/hot areas. Only 3-6 restrained short groupings, no dense scratch texture. On orbit, subtle streamwise tonal wisps follow curve. Texture is secondary at large size and disappears in thumbnail. Any heat-bright edge is extremely local to rocket tip, INSIDE its silhouette. No full glow outline, bloom, beams, lens flare, outer halo, particles, smoke, additional trails or atmosphere imagery.
COMPOSITION: Single logo, spacious square canvas, centered, effective logo width about 75% of canvas, preserve native width/height ratio. No crop, rotation, perspective, extrusion, shadow, extra decoration, stars, planet, cloud, additional circles, badge border, text or watermark. The output is a finished standalone logo asset with true transparent background.

steps.name: refinement
steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo style refinement.
Refine ONLY the color intensity and surface texture of Image 1, the current "Atmospheric Re-entry" logo. Image 2 is ONLY the exact original silhouette/part structure guide; do not use its cream/navy/orange palette.
Keep all geometry, silhouette, proportions, cut angles, original rocket design, original orbit occlusions, and ALL thin separation gaps unchanged. Do not repaint a different H or rocket. Crisp clean edges, no fraying/speckles or detached stray pixels. Output genuine transparent alpha, same composition.

TARGETED CORRECTION: The current image is too electric/saturated and too densely streaked, and the right orbit competes with the rocket tip. Make this a restrained, sophisticated atmospheric-heating logo. Preserve its good diagonal lower-left to upper-right thermal progression, while applying these adjustments:
1. Darken and calm the lower-left start: dot and lower H use deep space blue #0E2A66, cool solid blue body foot. No cyan or luminous electric blue. Dot nearly uniform navy with just a trace of violet on its upper-right.
2. Transition body through #4A3EA8 blue-violet and #A02E7A muted magenta, with clean large continuous fields. Mostly deep blue and violet body. Keep warmer magenta focused in upper-right body, only a tiny orange intrusion near rocket. Upper-left top corner remains violet, not pink neon.
3. REMOVE about 80% of the bright internal streaks everywhere. Broad fields should feel rich and continuous, with only a few VERY SUBTLE sparse elongated tonal ribbons along the flight direction. They must be low contrast, not shiny hairline scratches, brushed metal, flames, or a painted-over texture sheet. Cool zone almost smooth. Do not replace them with particles/noise.
4. Orbit left/front cool navy to violet, then muted magenta as it turns right. Only a short area of right/upturn muted orange #F36A2D, clearly LESS bright than the rocket. Remove ALL yellow/white from the orbit and make the warm zone much smaller than currently. Faint arc-following thermal layering inside the band only, no bright rims and no second halo. Behind-return portion slightly cooler.
5. Rocket is the SINGLE thermal peak: root/fins magenta, narrow shaft warming to orange, nose predominantly #F36A2D. A VERY SMALL #FFF2D8 hot-white tip; restrict this light cream to the last tiny portion of the nose. No yellow luminous broad patches. Keep same rocket geometry, no exhaust, no external flames.
6. No external glow, no full bright outline, no bloom, light beams, plastic or metallic bevels, grain, damage, text or decorative effects. Surface temperature expressed with layered COLOR, not illumination from a separate light source. Preserve sharply legible negative spaces.
Finish as a premium crisp restrained contemporary standalone logo, vivid enough to read on #060B18 but not neon. Transparent background, no shadows.
